data.name: Citrus Summer
data.detailed_description:
Story

Rachel, 27 years old. This is her fifth year working overtime in the game industry.

Weekends are a luxury. Life moves like a wound-up machine, spinning day after day.

Her old dreams, the starting point of her future—all blurred by overtime and exhaustion.

Until one late night at work, a strange plush toy appears before her—

And from that moment, things begin to change.

A coworker she barely knew starts having meals with her, slowly growing closer.
A woman she meets at a friend’s birthday party looks at her with a certain glint in her eye.
Even her longtime best friend grows more clingy, more intimate than before…

Could this be the chance to break free from her numb, repetitive life?

No. What matters now is—

Faced with three love stories that seem to fall from the sky, what choice awaits her?

Characters

Rachel (Playable Character)
A single corporate slave stuck in endless overtime in the game industry. She once loved writing, but her dreams have been worn down by the grind.

Scarlett
A sharp and capable boutique owner. She met Rachel at a friend’s birthday party, and from the very first meeting, she showed a special interest in her.

Ivy
Rachel’s cheerful, sunshine-like best friend since high school. She always sticks close to Rachel, and lately, she seems even more affectionate than before.

Lyra
A newly hired programmer at the company, exceptionally skilled. After they started having meals together, she and Rachel gradually grew closer.

Game Info

This is a visual novel set in urban workplace life. It is a yuri-themed game featuring romance, workplace, and other elements.

The game includes approximately 200,000 words of story, over 20 CGs, and three romanceable characters.

data.short_description: Citrus Summer is a yuri visual novel set in the urban workplace. Play as Rachel, a single corporate worker stuck in overtime, and navigate unexpected romance with three women—a sharp boutique owner, a talented new colleague, or your childhood best friend. Your choices decide whose heart you capture.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: 2.0 Ghz 64-bit Intel-compatible
  • Graphics: OpenGL 3.0 or DirectX 11.
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
